Need to write formative feedback. Let's craft.

Summary: You present a clear, well-written mission rationale for GBR monitoring and a readable report, but technical design and planning need work: the 600 km GEO orbit is incorrect, no quantified requirements or preliminary technical results, and the plan lacks contingencies and a source list. Weighted ~57/100.

Next steps: 3 actionable. E.g., 1) Correct orbit: GEO ~35,786 km and cannot be fixed over non-equatorial GBR; choose LEO sun-synchronous/appropriate orbit and derive altitude, revisit, resolution. 2) Add quantified mission requirements (spatial resolution, revisit time, spectral bands, data latency) and formal citations with access dates. 3) Add contingency/risk provision and reconcile Gantt dates with text and due date; include explicit information-source list and preliminary technical results (STK outputs/calcs).

Criteria:
C1 <=70 words: You clearly explain mission purpose, users and rationale with references. To reach Accomplished, quantify mission requirements—spatial resolution, revisit time, spectral bands, data latency—and tie each to user needs. Qualify bleaching mortality figures as mainly shallow-water northern GBR, not whole reef. Replace footnote URLs with formal citations including access dates.

C2: Your Gantt chart and task breakdown make the plan credible. For Accomplished, add contingency/risk provision and an explicit list of planned information sources. Reconcile inconsistencies: text says editing Weeks 7–8 but chart shows Weeks 9–10; chart ends 16/11 while final report is due 20/11. Explain plan choices in context of mission.

C3: You completed STK tutorials 1–4 and background research. To move from Adequate to Accomplished, present preliminary technical results—e.g., STK orbit/sensor outputs, coverage/revisit calculations, link or data-rate estimates—with brief interpretation showing you are on track. Currently no calculations or simulation outputs demonstrate design progress.

C4: Well-structured, readable and consistent; Gantt is clear and labelled, and footnotes match in-text citations. To secure Accomplished, add a formal reference list and a figure caption for the Gantt chart. Minor formatting refinements only.
